en: I am Karen of the Elite Four. You're {player}? How amusing.
My Pokémon are of the Dark type. Untamed, hard to read, and far tougher than they look.
Think you can take them? Just try to entertain me. Let's go.
Well, aren't you good. I like that in a trainer.
People love to sort Pokémon into the strong and the weak. I've never had much patience for that. The best trainers win with the ones they love.
You fight like someone who knows it. Go on. The Champion is waiting.
The Champion is through that door. Go on. Don't keep him waiting.
